annotations.text:
The organising idea

Everything the group needs help with is the same shape: a thing that needs a person attached to it by a date.

So the portal stops being a status board and becomes a shared queue of claimable work with visible owners.

Needs someone / You're on

The two sections a volunteer actually acts on, above everything else. Every card says how long it will take.

'Around the group' exists so the place feels populated — including the nudge that two people have offered to help and nobody has replied.

Notion is demoted, not hidden

No card ends in 'Open in Notion ↗' any more. It survives as one quiet line at the bottom of the page for committee members who want it.

All names, dates, streets and consultations here are illustrative sample content — chosen to look like real Lambeth material so the layout can be judged honestly. Nothing on these screens is live data.
